commit.message:
Preserve Copilot permission denials in daemon bridge

Keep the original Copilot denial object for permissionRequest and permissionRequestV2 instead of translating availability into a Claude-shaped allow response. Add direct producer, alias, registration, malformed-transport and other-harness regression coverage.

Validation: 185 selected tests passed, including 36 new cases; Ruff and type checks passed. Existing Python semantic-callgraph and capability-cleanup gates passed. No policy, deadline or general availability behavior change.
